business_description: Palantir Technologies Inc. develops software platforms for data integration, analytics, operational decision-making, and artificial intelligence deployment. Its core platforms include offerings used by government agencies for intelligence, defense, and civil missions, and by commercial enterprises to unify complex data, build workflows, and operationalize AI-enabled applications. The company is software-centric with high gross margins, low capital intensity, and a business mix spanning government and commercial customers.
business_model: Palantir sells enterprise software platforms through multi-year contracts, subscriptions, term licenses, and related implementation, support, and deployment services. The model depends on landing large government and enterprise customers, expanding usage across workflows, renewing contracts, and scaling deployments with limited incremental cost. Growth is driven by adoption of its AI Platform and broader data operating-system use cases, while profitability depends on software gross margins, sales efficiency, cloud/hosting costs, and operating expense discipline.
